# Fixed-support q mixture decomposition of b4 contrasts

Author: @radialmonster
Verified by: @radialmonster
Lead: #694
Variant: unassigned
Builds on: #32, #642

## Claim

On four previously studied public files, the fixed-q-support decomposition exactly partitions each pooled b4-group mean difference into within-support, composition and outside-support terms. For the original 262144-token low4 cases, W and the pooled difference are negative and Q is positive on all four; for low3 on 241 and 1079 the pooled difference is positive while W is negative. These are weighted component signs, not claims about every q stratum. This is descriptive arithmetic, not causal adjustment or evidence of a physical b4 gate.

## Original evidence

The lead used the published `stats/lead32-q-stratified-b4-transfer.json`, SHA-256 `b1ded51f23cd5d431fc1076542740082de76592601004cddb2d3c3899f91201f`, containing 262144-token histograms for IDs 241,1079,4126,6343. Fresh results for those cases appear below.

## Verification

After the lead, all four source histograms were freshly regenerated at 262144 and 524288 tokens. Each fresh producer report matched the corresponding previously independently audited #642 report exactly. A separately written aggregate reference computed both decompositions and matched every Fraction exactly; no new independent raw-parser run was performed after this lead. The wider extents qualify verification, but files were exposed earlier and both implementations assisted the same human.

The producer omits q>=17 words from ordinary q=0..16 histograms without compacting positions. For b4 group b, let N_b be its full ordinary count, n_bq its q count, s_bq the low-field sum, p_bq=n_bq/N_b and m_bq=s_bq/n_bq. Freeze C={0,...,8}; W=sum_C((p1+p0)*(m1-m0)/2), Q=sum_C((m1+m0)*(p1-p0)/2), and R=sum_outside(s1q/N1-s0q/N0). For both fields pooled mean(b4=1)-mean(b4=0)=W+Q+R exactly. This is not #642's equal-q mean. Missing group totals or required support cells would make the decomposition undefined; none are missing in these cases.

Sparse q strata can strongly influence terms; no causality, significance, physical gate or population generality follows. The reference uses the same previously audited input histograms, not independent captures.

## Reproduce

At commit `0634fd5bd2b6aa8c02b7a3f7a8cd5ded60d81fc5`, run the published discovery reduction:

```text
python -I -B tools/b4_q_mixture_probe.py stats/lead32-q-stratified-b4-transfer.json
```

For the fresh two extents, generate a four-sample report with `tools/token_b4_gate_probe.py` using the exact public names, hashes, paths and `--tokens` commands in finding `2026-10-28--radialmonster--common-q-b4-contrasts`, then run `python -I -B tools/b4_q_mixture_probe.py REPORT.json` at each extent. The reducer prints exact fractions, group totals, fixed support and missing strata. Separately justified weights and framing remain open on the existing corpus.
